brief.t: START HERE: Open Men’s Moisturizer with Evelyn and reconcile usable stock against the October 30 run.

ACT NOW 1: Validate Men’s Moisturizer before Friday’s recorded run. CRM project51 lists October30 production, only2 days away, but remains Sample Batching and has no production assignee. Its21-of25 shortage flag and16 needed purchasing lines require reconciliation; blank ordered/QC/released columns are not proof of zero stock. Aidan’s validation task dueOctober26 is2 days overdue. Send internally: Evelyn, please review the Men’s Moisturizer stock and incoming orders with me today and confirm who owns the October 30 run and whether that date is still realistic.

ACT NOW 2: Confirm Oreka’s QC and finished-sample shipping plan. Nikkie reports her task handled, but Ron still reported Oreka R&D inprogress yesterday. The lab agenda requires physical, viscosity and pH results before shipment consideration. No verified shipping approval, actual dispatch or tracking; Mibelle’s latest request is still for a Canada address. Nadia’s response task dueOctober14 is14days overdue; arrival needed beforeNovember1. Send internally: Michael and Evelyn, please send the Oreka test results, shipping approval and delivery plan today so we can confirm Nadia will receive the finished samples in Canada before November 1.

ACT NOW 3: Retrieve Evelyn’s lot-matched Bulk Apothecary COAs. Evelyn’s October26 request for Cheirosa62 and Zinc Oxide COAs is2days old. No matching COAs or affected-job release deadline found; a production stop is not confirmed. Send internally: Evelyn, please send the Cheirosa 62 and Zinc Oxide lot numbers and the job that needs them so I can get you the matching COAs today.

next: Recommendation: Validate Friday’s run first, then secure Oreka’s delivery and Evelyn’s COAs.
